title: Routine Hub – DIU CSE Routine Scraper
summary: Built a routine-scraping website for the Daffodil International University (DIU) CSE Department that helps students quickly find and view section-wise class routines instead of manually searching through massive unstructured routine files.
features: Automated web scraping of official DIU CSE class routine data
Fast section-wise search, filtering, and room schedule queries
Clean, responsive user interface built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS
Database persistence and API caching using Supabase and Prisma

title: Custom Compiler Design
summary: Led a team to build a working custom compiler around Context-Free Grammar (CFG) rules, lexical analysis, and core compiler design concepts.
features: Lexical analyzer / tokenizer to process input tokens and keywords
Parser based on Context-Free Grammar (CFG) rules and syntax tree generation
Error handling and symbol table management for variable scopes
Clear validation and syntactic analysis

title: Hospital Management System
summary: Built a robust relational database management system using SQL to handle complex hospital operations including patient records, doctor scheduling, and prescriptions.
features: Relational schema design with normalized tables, foreign keys, and integrity constraints
Patient record management, admissions, and history tracking
Doctor appointment schedules, specialization tracking, and consultation records
Pharmacy and medicine prescription management workflow

title: Banking System
type: Data Structure & OOP Labs · Lead Developer
summary: Developed banking software in C for account creation, deposits, and semester fee payments, and later refactored and extended the application using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) in C++.
features: Secure user account creation, authentication, and balance tracking
Deposit, withdrawal, and semester fee transaction processing
Refactored using OOP principles (Encapsulation, Inheritance, Classes) for modularity
Robust input validation and file-based state persistence

title: River Crossing Puzzle Game
summary: Created an interactive river-crossing puzzle game where players solve classic constraint-based problem-solving challenges with visual characters, move validation, and level progression.
features: Interactive constraint-satisfaction game logic in JavaScript
Visual river crossing animations, character movements, and boat capacity checks
Rule enforcement (preventing predator-prey conflicts when left alone)
Level progression, victory/defeat state handling, and clean UI

title: Command Line File Manager
summary: Built a lightweight, interactive file manager that runs completely inside the command line using Bash scripting in a POSIX Linux environment.
features: File navigation, directory listing, creation, renaming, and deletion
Permission viewing and file inspection without exiting the CLI interface
Built strictly with standard Bash and core POSIX Unix utilities
Designed for speed, low overhead, and ease of use in headless server environments

title: Portfolio Website & Intelligent AI Assistant
summary: Personal portfolio website featuring an intelligent, query-aware AI assistant powered by Google Gemini SDK with Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, sub-second TTFT, automatic retries, and comprehensive domain knowledge.

Adaptive output limits (up to 2500 tokens) with query-aware dynamic knowledge retrieval
Official Google GenAI SDK integration with gemini-3.5-flash-lite and gemini-3.5-flash fallback
Fluent bilingual (Bangla & English) understanding and response generation
Fullscreen interactive achievement photo gallery with keyboard navigation
